company_updates.about: Cedar Labs builds clinic scheduling tools. Its pilot codename is Juniper-47. The pilot covers twelve pediatric clinics. Its public website is https://cedar.example/.
Harbor Tools makes woodworking tools. Its workshop program is called Birch-21 and serves seven schools. Its public website is https://harbor.example/.
